verdict.rationale: Trello is a visual project-management and kanban tool, not an AI coding agent, so restoring a coding agent's session to a previous checkpoint is a category error for this product. Nothing in the evidence shows Trello running coding-agent sessions or keeping session checkpoints. Its MCP server and AI writing help are different capabilities and do not make this axis apply.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can restore an AI coding agent's session to any previous checkpoint in its version history
